attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and says outright that nothing more is known: «Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου». That is a want of knowledge and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry; the page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. He is none of the corpus's three other Conons — of Isauria and the Gardener, both on 5 March, and of Penthucla on 19 February: saint.gr keeps this man alone on 5 June, from Rome, and drowned in the sea. The page gives no year and prints no hymn.
